items: Liquids bhi gases ki tarah diffuse hote (phailte) hain, lekin liquids mein diffusion ki speed gases se bohat kam hoti hai.
Liquid ke molecules ke darmiyan jagah kam hoti hai, kyunke un ki intermolecular forces gas ke muqable mein mazboot hoti hain.
Liquids gases se 10⁵ guna kam compress hote hain, lekin solids se taqreeban 10 guna zyada.

Liquid ke molecules hamesha be-tarteeb (random) harkat mein rehte hain, magar gas ke molecules se aahista. Miscible (aapas mein mil jane wale) liquids ka ek doosre mein diffuse hona is azad harkat ka saboot hai. Isi azad harkat ki wajah se liquids beh (flow kar) sakte hain.
Temperature barhane par liquids phailte (expand hote) hain, lekin yeh phailao gases ke muqable mein na hone ke barabar hai.

Kinetic molecular theory ke mutabiq liquid ke molecules hamesha harkat mein rehte hain, is liye har temperature par un ke paas kuch kinetic energy (KE) hoti hai. Temperature barhe to KE barhti hai, ghate to ghat jati hai. Maslan thanda karne par KE kam hoti hai aur liquid solid ban jata hai; garam karne par KE barhti hai aur liquid vapour (bhaap) ban jata hai.

blocks.alt: Piston wale chaar cylinder. (a) 1 atm par hawa, aur 2 atm par wahi hawa jis ka piston aadhe volume tak neeche chala gaya. (b) 1 atm par pani, aur 2 atm par piston taqreeban nahi hila: liquid ka volume sirf taqreeban 0.0045 faisad badalta hai.

blocks.text: Figure 5.1: pressure double karne par hawa (gas) ka volume aadha ho jata hai, magar pani (liquid) ka volume sirf taqreeban 0.0045% badalta hai. Liquid ke molecules pehle hi qareeb qareeb hain, dabane ke liye khali jagah bohat kam hai.

blocks.prompt: Do miscible liquids ko aahista se ek beaker mein dal kar chhor dein; kuch der baad woh baghair hilaye mil jate hain. Yeh liquid ki kaun si property hai, aur yeh gas se aahista kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Yeh diffusion hai, jo liquid molecules ki musalsal random harkat se hota hai. Yeh gas se aahista hai kyunke liquid ke molecules qareeb qareeb hain, un ke darmiyan jagah kam hai aur mazboot intermolecular forces unhen aahista chalne deti hain.

items: Liquids: diffusion gas se aahista; molecules ke darmiyan jagah kam; gas se 10⁵ guna kam aur solid se 10 guna zyada compressible; random harkat ki wajah se behte hain; thora sa expand hote hain.
KE kam karne (thanda) par liquid solid banta hai, KE barhane (garam) par vapour.
